title: The Red Shoes (The Angel's Mercy)
summary: Tortured by the enchanted dancing shoes that would not let her rest, the maiden Karen sought the executioner's hut, demanding the severance of her vain desire....
full_text:
Tortured by the enchanted dancing shoes that would not let her rest, the maiden Karen sought the executioner's hut, demanding the severance of her vain desire.

On wooden crutches, she devoted her remaining years to the service of the poor, sweeping the church steps and offering tears of humble sorrow.

When the angel with the golden lily appeared before her in the nave, her soul was released from the fiery torment of vanity, ascending in radiant forgiveness to the throne of mercy.
moral: Sincere repentance purifies the heart and opens the gates of eternal peace.
